abstract: Configure Pydantic AI (Python pydantic-ai 2.x) against self-hosted OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints: vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM and llama-swap. Covers OpenAIChatModel with OpenAIProvider, VLLMProvider, OllamaProvider, LiteLLMProvider and AnthropicProvider, why bare openai: means Responses, model profiles, key handling without printing secrets, output modes (Tool, Native, Prompted), tool calling, streaming, thinking fields, single-system-message backends, troubleshooting, and a curl and jq probe script.
